observations: Three photos show a tall, white, standing air conditioner unit wrapped in plastic, standing next to its outdoor condenser unit.
The outdoor unit has a blue 'Midea' logo clearly visible on the front grille in all three photos.
The indoor unit is tall and rectangular, with a control panel and remote image printed on the front, also wrapped in plastic.
The unit is in an outdoor market setting with other appliances and people around.
The indoor unit has a small sticker with 'Quick Cooling' and an image of a remote control.
No model number or serial number is visible on any part of the unit in the photos.
The unit appears to be new or lightly used, as it is still wrapped in protective plastic and cardboard.

claims.claim: Tokunbo sharp and mint direct tokunbo Midea foreitn used standing air conditioners.
claims.evidence: The brand 'Midea' is visible on the outdoor unit in all photos, but 'Tokunbo' (imported used) and 'mint' (like new) are not verifiable from the photos alone. The term 'foreitn' is likely a typo for 'foreign'. The unit appears wrapped and clean, but internal condition and usage history are unknown.

risks.risk: The unit may be damaged internally or have been previously used, despite the wrapping.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the indoor unit's control panel, vents, and internal components, and a video of the unit running with the remote.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly not working or with hidden damage

risks.risk: The unit may not be the model or capacity claimed, or may be a reconditioned unit misrepresented as new.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number and serial number on the indoor or outdoor unit, preferably on a label or sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown model, which may affect performance and value

risks.risk: The remote control may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual remote control and a video showing it operating the unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as without remote, which reduces value

proof_requests: A clear photo of the model number and serial number on the indoor or outdoor unit.
A video of the unit running with the remote control.
A close-up photo of the indoor unit's control panel and vents.
A photo of the actual remote control.
response.reason: The brand 'Midea' is confirmed, but the model number is not visible, and the condition claims ('mint', 'tokunbo') cannot be verified. Hidden risks include internal damage, missing remote, and unknown model capacity. These must be proven before pricing can be determined accurately.
